text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—I gave it everything I had and 
finished... in 1st place!! All that's left 
is whether my feelings reached that girl 
through my running, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"She told me she's gonna run again! 
Because my runnin' was... d-dazzlin'. She 
said she wants to become the second 'Star 
of Morioka'!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"As the first 'Star of Morioka,' I ain't 
gonna lose! After this, it's celebration 
party time with the whole village. I'll 
recharge my batteries and keep givin' it 
my best tomorrow on!"
